metadata.title: TidalTrack Catalog: 480 controlled N-body tidal-evolution simulations
metadata.description:
Initial distribution (v0.1.0) of 480 time-dependent subhalo and stellar catalogs. The original HDF5 bytes are preserved; particle snapshots and intermediate data are excluded. Includes simulation metadata, SHA256 manifests and a README.

Known limitations: HBT/BoundR200CritComoving contains infinite values and is not a usable physical radius; derived fields contain NaNs; some recorded input particle counts precede pruning. Actual IC-header counts are provided separately. See the included README for measurement definitions and scientific limitations.
